11.6  The Owner may only terminate this Agreement with the written consent of the Licensee.
findings.explanation: The client can terminate the agreement at any time, but you can only exit if the client gives written consent, restricting your termination rights.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving written notice to the other parties.
